rst31-v2-coupon-timing-q001.objective: Choose when to hand over a return-visit coupon.
rst31-v2-coupon-timing-q001.stem: A restaurant prepares discount coupons for the next visit. When should staff hand a coupon to the guest?
rst31-v2-coupon-timing-q001.explanation: Hand over a return-visit coupon during register checkout. Avoid confusing an arrival-time handout with a discount for that day.
reasons: Hand it over at checkout, rather than on arrival.
Hand it over at checkout, rather than when taking the order.
This matches handing over a return-visit coupon at checkout.
Hand it over at the guest's checkout, rather than when cooking starts.
